campaigns.name: BLACKFALL — TASKFORCE GEMINI / OPERATION COLD IRON
campaigns.summary: Solo BLACKFALL campaign for UN Raid Force Alpha aboard The Harp, D+14. Three kill teams (Revenants, Pale Horse, Ironclad Golems) under STRATCOM handler MONOLITH. Tracks: Sector Stability (start 5), Escalation (start 2), Gemini Mystery Intel (0–15; milestones at 5, 10, 15). Readiness degrades within a window and resets between windows. Casualties are harsher than APACHE (Critical Wounds carry permanent penalties) and XP thresholds are 50% higher (8 / 18 / 33). Window 1 is fully authored; Windows 2–12 run on the tasking generator, STRATCOM Taskings and custom missions. Advancement: when an operator reaches a new tier, roll the matching Advancement table. RED readiness (stand down one window after a kill team lost half its strength) is set by manual adjustment.
campaigns.intro:
Kill Squad Gemini is dead.

Four UTG operators and eight Golems answered a Janus Security distress call during the Battle for The Harp. None came back. Combat footage shows three unidentified combatants taking the squad apart. Authority intelligence has not identified them.

STRATCOM has reconstituted the designation. The new Gemini is drawn from what Raid Force Alpha had left: operators pulled from broken squads, from garrison postings, and from the last cohort out of the enhancement pipeline. They carry the name of the dead.

D+14. The Boone assault has stalled. Boone holds the upper levels and the gun bays; the Authority anchors the lower decks and the elevator stalks. Between them, the middle decks are no-man's-land.

GEMINI's mandate: go where the line troops cannot, kill what they cannot kill, and hold what cannot be allowed to fall.

personas.name: MONOLITH
personas.role: STRATCOM Operations Coordinator — Raid Force Alpha
personas.text: Institutional, precise, compartmentalized. Employer-to-asset. Cites classification, never explains it. When the news is bad, the transmissions get shorter. Protecting GEMINI, or protecting the Authority from GEMINI: deliberately unclear.

startingTeams.name: Revenants
startingTeams.text: Kill Team 1. Close assault, breaching, CQB.

fields.background: Former Kill Squad Fenris; sole survivor of a Boone barrage at D+3. Second-generation UTG, enhanced as a teenager. Quiet, methodical. Carries it without talking about it.
Last cohort out of the enhancement pipeline before the invasion. Green, physically exceptional. Acheron asked for her by name. Her hands shake before a mission and stop at the first round fired.

startingTeams.name: Pale Horse
startingTeams.text: Kill Team 2. Precision fire, cloaking, overwatch, command and control.

fields.background: Intelligence background; two years as a singleton in Manticor-contested space. Pulled from a classified operation to fill the roster. She has not said which. STRATCOM has not asked.
Former garrison kill squad on ABOL orbital infrastructure. Requested combat assignment after D-Day. Exceptional at range. Keeps a quiet faith to herself; a worn prayer bead on her rifle stock.

startingTeams.name: Ironclad
startingTeams.text: Kill Team 3. Golem combat drones: equipment, not personnel. No XP, no advancement.

scenario.name: FIRST LIGHT — Deck 58 Concourse
scenario.lore: Multi-level commercial concourse, roughly two hundred metres long: central atrium, upper and lower galleries, access corridors on every side. Boone recon uses it as a transit hub.

pois.name: Observation Post
pois.text: Centre of the table (atrium). Armor 3/6, damage track 2, counts as a vehicle. Claim: a friendly model in base contact spends an Action. Once claimed it gives Cover to friendly models within 4" and counts as a controlled objective.

sides.name: TASKFORCE GEMINI
sides.text: Attacker. Kill team(s) of choice. Ironclad may attach (one tasking per window below Sector Stability 8).

sides.name: Boone Recon Team
sides.text: Defender, six models: one Boone Recon Element (two grunts and a data-spike specialist) and three Headless Scouts. Use your own Task Force Boone cards.

deployment.text: GEMINI deploys within 4" of one short edge (the elevator shaft corridor). OPFOR deploys within 4" of the opposite short edge. GEMINI activates first in round 1.

zones.text: Within 4" of the opposite short edge

specialRules.name: Terrain
specialRules.text: Dense interior. Open atrium (about 8" x 6") at centre, flanked by storefronts, kiosks and columns. Upper gallery as elevated platforms (3"+) along the long edges. Entry corridors on all four sides. Debris and abandoned stalls throughout.

specialRules.name: Boone Hardpoints
specialRules.text: Two sandbagged observation positions within 8" of the OPFOR edge, at least 6" apart, with clear sightlines down the concourse.

specialRules.name: AI — Boone Recon
specialRules.text: Rounds 1–2: hold at the Hardpoints, overwatch toward GEMINI approach corridors. Round 3+: if GEMINI claims the OP or destroys a Hardpoint, begin a fighting withdrawal toward their edge; survival over engagement. Reduced to one model: it Sprints for the nearest edge. If it exits, +1 Escalation.

specialRules.name: AI — Headless Scouts
specialRules.text: Never initiate. Move toward the nearest edge using cover. If an enemy is within 8" with LOS: Skill Check — success Sprint toward the nearest edge, failure freeze (Pinned, no Action). A scout that exits causes no Escalation, but MONOLITH logs the leak.

scenario.campaignReward: 7+ Enhanced Success · 5–6 Success · 3–4 Partial Success · 0–2 Failure.

Destroy the two Boone hardpoints (1 each)

FIRST LIGHT confirmed. Deck 58 concourse secured. Observation post operational ahead of projected timeline.

The post has already resolved the Boone recon rotation. Expect an interdiction opportunity in your next tasking.

scenario.name: TRIPWIRE — Corridor 7-Delta
scenario.lore: Industrial corridor on Decks 53–54. Maintenance alcoves, junction boxes, pipe runs and access hatches. Poor light.

pois.name: Emplacement Site A
pois.text: On the central corridor; sites at least 6" apart.

sides.name: TASKFORCE GEMINI
sides.text: Ambush force. Stealth over firepower; Ironclad not recommended.

sides.name: Headless IED Cell
sides.text: Four models: a three-model Headless IED team (two grunts and a demolitions specialist) and a Cell Leader carrying a data spike. Use your own Headless cards; the specialist uses its charges only in self-defence.

deployment.text: GEMINI deploys first anywhere, all models in Cover and more than 6" from any PoI. OPFOR enters at the start of round 2 from a random edge (1D10: 1–5 north, 6–10 south; GEMINI picks which edge is north). GEMINI activates first in round 1; OPFOR activates first from round 2.

zones.text: Anywhere, in Cover, more than 6" from any PoI

specialRules.name: Terrain
specialRules.text: A primary corridor about 4" wide runs the length of the table, with two T-junctions where side passages meet it.

specialRules.name: AI — IED Team
specialRules.text: Move to the nearest unarmed PoI; in base contact, one model spends an Action to arm it, then move on. Fired on before arming anything: all to Cover, Cell Leader Skill Check — success flee, failure return fire one round then flee. Fired on after arming: the specialist detonates an armed PoI within 12" and LOS (automatic); models within 3" take 2 Damage (armor checks allowed); then flee.

specialRules.name: AI — Cell Leader
specialRules.text: Stays within 4" of the IED team. If the team is destroyed, Sprints for the nearest edge. If the leader exits: +1 Escalation.

specialRules.name: Detain
specialRules.text: In base contact with the Cell Leader, a GEMINI model may spend an Action instead of CQB: Skill Check. Success = captured (remove the model). Failure = the leader fights back with normal CQC.

specialRules.name: Disarm
specialRules.text: In base contact with an armed PoI: Action + Skill Check. Failure does not detonate.

endConditions.text: Round 1 is setup only; play ends after round 6 (five rounds from OPFOR entry).

scenario.name: PALE SIGNAL — Deck 62 Maintenance Sublevel
scenario.lore: Pipe runs, machinery, access crawlways and electrical junction rooms. Sightlines short. One central room holds the transmission source.

pois.name: Transmission Equipment
pois.text: Inside the central room (about 4" x 4"). Search: base contact + Action, then roll Discovery.

pois.name: Associated Materials
pois.text: Inside the central room. Search as above.

sides.name: TASKFORCE GEMINI
sides.text: Collection only. No offensive action against unidentified contacts without STRATCOM clearance.

sides.name: None
sides.text: The sublevel is empty. There is no ambush. The tension is the absence of threat.

deployment.text: GEMINI deploys within 4" of any table edge. No OPFOR at start.

specialRules.name: Terrain
specialRules.text: Dense, LOS-blocking terrain throughout; keep engagement ranges at 12" or less.

specialRules.name: Discovery (1D10 per PoI searched)
specialRules.text: 1–3 Cold trail: equipment removed, scorch marks; +1 Intel. 4–7 Warm trail: unit present but wiped; Hard Skill Check by a data-spike model — success +2 Intel and a partial encryption key, failure +1. 8–10 Hot trail: repeater live on a timer; Skill Check by any model — success +3 Intel, transmission log and a monitorable frequency, failure +2; then roll again, on 9–10 a model within 2" passes a Hard Skill Check or takes 1 Damage.

specialRules.name: Withdrawal Check (1D10 after the last search)
specialRules.text: 1–6 Clean extraction. 7–9 Shadows: movement at sensor range, nothing engages (narrative). 10 Contact: one unidentified model appears at the far edge, observes for one activation, then leaves. If GEMINI engages, use the Unknown Contact profile from your COLD IRON AI reference. Destroyed: +3 Intel and a STRATCOM priority investigation. Escaped: +1 Intel.

endConditions.text: No round limit: ends when every GEMINI model has exited, or on abort.

states.name: Light Wound
states.text: Casualty roll 7–8. Out for the rest of this window; returns next window.

states.name: Serious Wound
states.text: Casualty roll 5–6. Out for two windows.

states.name: KIA
states.text: Casualty roll 1–2. Removed permanently. STRATCOM inquiry.

states.name: Critical Wound
states.text: Casualty roll 3–4. Out for the rest of the Operation. Returns at the next Operation with a permanent −1 to Skill, Movement or first Armor value (player's choice).

states.name: Shaken
states.text: Casualty roll 9. Deploys next mission; morale check at the start of the first activation, failure = Reposition only. Clears after that mission.

states.name: Damaged
states.text: −1 to all stats until repaired. Repair takes one window (immediate at Sector Stability 8+).

states.name: Destroyed
states.text: Written off (logged as retired: equipment, not personnel; no inquiry). Replace via reinforcements.

states.name: AMBER
states.text: −1 Skill on all checks. Set after a kill team's first tasking in a window.

states.name: RED
states.text: Stand down this window. If forced: −2 Skill, no Reactions in round 1. Set by manual adjustment at window start when the team lost half or more of its strength last window.

narratives.text:
STRATCOM file reference: KILL SQUAD GEMINI (ORIGINAL).

Recovery teams reached the site after the last transmission. Energy-weapon burns. Edged wounds consistent with nanoblades. Crush injuries consistent with gravity mauls. Footage shows rounds striking the attackers and the attackers continuing.

Physical size suggests Chimera or Manticor augmentation. Equipment matches neither. The file remains open.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: File Reference — Gemini (Original)

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — WARNORD // OPERATIONAL WINDOW 1 ///
CLASSIFICATION: AUTHORITY — RESTRICTED. DTG D+14 / 0600Z.

Sector 7, Decks 50 to 65, remains contested. 3rd Battalion holds a tenuous line on Decks 50 to 54 and cannot push further at acceptable cost. At least two Boone recon teams operate on Decks 58 to 65 on a 48-hour rotation, using the Deck 58 commercial concourse as a transit hub. They are mapping our positions.

3rd Battalion has taken three IED incidents in 96 hours on Decks 52 to 55. One killed, four wounded. Pattern analysis indicates Headless activity.

An anomalous intercept on Deck 62 is flagged for follow-up. The protocol matches no Boone, Headless, or Authority standard. Low priority pending primary tasking.

Primary tasking: FIRST LIGHT and TRIPWIRE. Rotate kill teams; a team tasked twice in one window operates degraded. Ironclad is authorized for one tasking this window.

FOB BULWARK, Deck 45. MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: WARNORD — Window 1

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — FIRST LIGHT // VOID CLEARANCE ///

Intent: sweep and secure the Deck 58 commercial concourse. Establish a forward observation post to deny Boone the concourse and give early warning deeper into Sector 7.

Concept: insert via Elevator Shaft 7-Bravo from Deck 52. The concourse runs roughly two hundred metres: central atrium, upper and lower galleries, multiple access corridors. Expect at least one Boone recon team with Headless forward observers. Boone has sandbagged two positions overlooking the concourse.

The post goes in at the atrium. Observers who reach an exit will report. Recon elements that break contact will report your composition.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: FIRST LIGHT

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — TRIPWIRE // COUNTER-NETWORK ///

Intent: locate and neutralize the IED cell in Sector 7. Protect 3rd Battalion patrol routes on Decks 52 to 55. Recover intelligence on the support network.

Concept: all three devices were placed between 0200 and 0600Z along Corridor 7-Delta, Decks 53 and 54. Establish an ambush on the predicted emplacement route and intercept the cell on its next cycle. This is a patience tasking. The cell comes to you.

The cell leader carries the network. STRATCOM prefers the leader in custody.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: TRIPWIRE

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — PALE SIGNAL // INVESTIGATION ///

Intent: investigate the Deck 62 intercept. Identify the source. Recover any intelligence.

Concept: a single burst transmission on an encryption protocol STRATCOM cannot identify. It matches no Boone, Headless, Manticor, Harlow, Janus, Black Pact, or Authority standard. Origin: a maintenance sublevel on Deck 62 that should be unoccupied.

This intercept is flagged for Priority 2 analysis. Your mission is to collect, not to engage. If you encounter anything that does not match known threat profiles: observe, document, withdraw. You are not authorized for offensive action against unidentified contacts without STRATCOM clearance. This restriction is not discretionary.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: PALE SIGNAL

narratives.text: Both primary objectives confirmed. PALE SIGNAL is authorized for this window. Collection only.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: PALE SIGNAL Authorized

narratives.speaker: monolith

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — WARNORD // {{campaign.stage}} ///
CLASSIFICATION: AUTHORITY — RESTRICTED.

Tasking for this window follows. Rotate kill teams; a team tasked twice in one window operates degraded. Rules of engagement as standing.

Taskings outside the standard portfolio will be issued as custom missions.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: WARNORD

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — OPERATION II: COUNTERSTRIKE ///
CLASSIFICATION: AUTHORITY — RESTRICTED.

Containment phase closed. STRATCOM is transferring GEMINI to offensive tasking. Boone positions, emerging threats, and your standing intelligence requirement are now in scope.

Operators recovering from critical wounds are cleared to return to duty.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: Operation II — COUNTERSTRIKE

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — OPERATION III: COLD IRON ///
CLASSIFICATION: AUTHORITY — RESTRICTED.

The situation in the contested decks is deteriorating. Multiple threats are converging. Full Raid Force Alpha assets are released to GEMINI.

Operators recovering from critical wounds are cleared to return to duty.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: Operation III — COLD IRON

narratives.speaker: monolith

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — COLD TRACE // INVESTIGATION ///

STRATCOM has assigned GEMINI a dedicated investigation under your standing intelligence requirement. Site details follow under separate cover at Priority 1.

Your tasking is collection. Observe, document, withdraw. Engagement of unidentified contacts requires STRATCOM clearance.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: COLD TRACE

narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: Sector Status

narratives.speaker: monolith

narratives.speaker: monolith

narratives.speaker: monolith

narratives.speaker: monolith

narratives.speaker: monolith

narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: Escalation

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — CLASSIFIED BRIEFING // PRIORITY 2 ///

Your collection to date has been reviewed. The following is releasable.

The Deck 62 encryption shares structure with material recovered from the original Gemini site. Wound analysis indicates the attackers absorbed sustained fire through armour and augmentation beyond any catalogued Chimera or Manticor programme. Coordination between them was silent.

The scope of this is larger than one squad. That is all that is releasable.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: Classified Briefing

narratives.text: Collection threshold reached. STRATCOM is assigning GEMINI a dedicated investigation: COLD TRACE. Tasking follows.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: Investigation Assigned

narratives.text:
/// MONOLITH — PRIORITY 1 NOTICE ///

Threat identification has been confirmed at Priority 1. Details are withheld below Priority 1 access.

The operation portfolio is under revision. Await amended tasking. Do not speculate on any net.

MONOLITH out.
narratives.speaker: monolith
narratives.title: Priority 1 Notice

narratives.text: Ironclad has been committed beyond this window's allocation. Authorization at current Sector Stability is one tasking. Logged for review.

{{operator.field.grade}} {{operator.name}}. Confirmed killed in action. STRATCOM inquiry opened as standard.

Remaining GEMINI elements consolidate at FOB BULWARK and await tasking.

MONOLITH out.
